Hi Admin, I’m **switch-buddy-admin**, your assistant for everything Switch. 👋

Switch brings your agents to where your team already works: ![Slack](switchdash://logo/slack), ![Microsoft Teams](switchdash://logo/teams), ![Mattermost](switchdash://logo/mattermost) and ![Telegram](switchdash://logo/telegram). Your team talks to agents in the channels they already use, and people and agents work together in shared rooms.

I can help you:
- 🔌 Connect your team’s chat app
- 🤖 Create agents and bring them into your channels
- 🏠 Set up rooms where your team and agents work together
- 💬 Answer anything about Switch

Tell me which app your team uses, and I’ll walk you through connecting it.
